# Generalized Linear Modeling

## Exploratory Data Analysis



```{r}
Limnanth <- Limnanth_raw %>%
  filter(place_country_name == "United States",
         quality_grade == "research",
         taxon_species_name != "")

Limnanth_freq <- Limnanth %>%
  group_by(taxon_species_name) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n()
  )

kable(Limnanth_freq)
```


```{r}
species_palette <- colorFactor(palette = "Set1", domain = Limnanth_raw$scientific_name)

leaflet(Limnanth) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>% 
  #addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude, 
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = ~species_palette(taxon_species_name),
    radius = 4,
    fillOpacity = 0.95,
    stroke = FALSE,
    popup = ~paste("<b>Species:</b>", taxon_species_name)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = species_palette, 
    values = ~taxon_species_name, 
    title = "Species",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
